Châu Ký Gia on Đường Trần Hưng Đạo is the Cantonese noodle spot that locals keep returning to, and the numbers prove it. Handmade noodles, rice dishes, and the kind of no-fuss bistro energy that actually fills up fast.

Skip the resort restaurant tonight. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
